title: Your rights and privacy
seo_title: Your rights and privacy when you are ill • React2u
seo_description: What does your employer get to know when you are ill, and what can you do if you disagree with something? Your rights and privacy at React2u.

data.heading: Your rights and privacy
data.text: Even when you are ill, you have rights. Here you can read what your employer does and does not get to know, and what you can do if you disagree with something.

data.heading: Your health is yours
data.text: Your employer only hears what is needed for your reintegration: what you can and cannot do, and roughly how long it will take. Your diagnosis and other medical information stay with the company doctor (bedrijfsarts), or with someone who works under the doctor's responsibility.

rows.title: What your employer does hear
rows.text: Whether you can work, what you can and cannot do, and when you expect to return.

rows.title: What your employer does not hear
rows.text: Your diagnosis, your medical details and what you discuss in confidence with the company doctor.

data.heading: Disagree with an advice or decision?
data.text: You are not on your own. These are your options.

cards.title: Medical details stay private
cards.text: Your employer only hears what you can and cannot do, never your diagnosis. Medical information stays with the company doctor.

cards.title: Second opinion
cards.text: Do you disagree with the company doctor? You can ask for a second opinion from another company doctor.

cards.title: Expert opinion by UWV
cards.text: Do you and your employer disagree about your reintegration? Then UWV, the Dutch Employee Insurance Agency, can give an independent opinion (deskundigenoordeel).

cards.title: Complaints procedure
cards.text: Not happy with us? You can file a complaint. We handle it with care. The procedure (PDF) is in Dutch.

data.heading: What you can ask about your data
data.text: Send your request to info@react2u.nl. We reply within four weeks.

data.heading: Unsure about your rights?
data.text: Feel free to call us. We explain it in plain language.
